title: Understand percent as parts per hundred on a 10 × 10 grid

lesson.title: Percent Means Out of One Hundred

steps.say: You already know how to shade a hundredths grid, where the whole big square is one and each tiny square is one hundredth. Today we give those tiny squares a new name, so we can read signs like thirty percent off at the mall.

visual.caption: The whole grid is 100 tiny squares

steps.say: Here is the big idea. The word percent just means out of one hundred. So on this ten by ten grid, one tiny square is one percent. If I colour twenty five squares, I have coloured twenty five out of one hundred, and that is twenty five percent.

Let us try a real one. A sign at the store says thirty percent off. That means for every one hundred dollars, thirty dollars come off. On our grid I colour thirty little squares in blue. Those blue squares are the savings, and the seventy white squares are what you still pay.

Now here is a trap I want you to dodge. Someone sees fifteen percent of forty and writes down fifteen. But look at the grid: fifteen percent is only fifteen tiny squares out of one hundred, a small slice, not even one fifth. Fifteen out of forty would be more than a third of the whole thing, which is much too big. A percent is never a plain amount all by itself.

visual.caption: 15 percent is a small slice of the whole

steps.say: So always ask yourself, fifteen percent of what? The percent tells you how much of each hundred you take, and the whole tells you how big each of those hundred pieces is. Fifteen percent of a chocolate bar and fifteen percent of a school bus are very different sizes, even though both are fifteen out of one hundred.
Here is what to remember. Percent means out of one hundred, so one little square on a ten by ten grid is one percent.

lesson.answer: Percent means out of one hundred — one square on a 10 by 10 grid is 1 percent.

practice.question: A poster at a Vancouver sports store says forty percent off all rain jackets. Imagine a ten by ten grid with one hundred tiny squares, and draw it if you like. How many tiny squares would you colour to show forty percent, and what fraction out of one hundred is that?
practice.answer: You colour 40 tiny squares, because 40 percent means 40 out of 100, which is the fraction 40 over 100 (the same as 4 tenths).
